change.pre_dispatch: When a live client tool set or host authorization hook makes delegation possible, checkpoint the provider assistant tool-call row before concurrent batch dispatch so every sibling tool has the same message ID.
change.publication_boundary: The actual delegated-tool execution invokes a per-turn locked checkpoint callback. It reads back the active matching assistant call and refuses publication if persistence cannot be proved. The callback is an independent backstop when preflight misses a routed client call.
change.repair: The existing same-conversation, same-position pending empty reservation repair remains the only repair path. A foreign or occupied row is refused.
change.ephemeral: store=False client delegation retains its preexisting no-message behavior; no durable assistant row is required for an explicitly unsaved run.
change.performance: Server-only runs with no live client tool set and no authorization hook avoid the added database barrier. In a client-connected batch, even a server-only call incurs one pre-dispatch finalize and readback to preserve mixed-batch assistant lineage. Multiple delegated calls in one batch reuse one checkpoint under a lock.

attribution_limit: The hosted public guest failure proved a completed tool row paired with a pending empty assistant reservation and a resume_context_not_ready 409. It did not prove whether the first checkpoint was skipped, dropped, or updated zero rows. Aidream currently does not wire a tool_authorization_hook; late authorization promotion is a supported package routing gap, not an established cause of the hosted incident.
